messages:
anna: Heads-up — found escaping issues in console docs examples for prompt templates (python + rust). Code fences render incorrectly when angle brackets present. Example PR ready but need guidance on canonical snippet formats.

sam-docs: Thanks. Which files? Can you paste the broken snippet?

anna: sources/docs/console/observability/presets.md (PR 3582). Broken example:
```
prompt_template = "Summarize: <user_input>\nTags: <tags>"
response = client.generate(prompt_template)
```
Rendered page strips the angle brackets, shows HTML entities.

leo-eng: That's the HTML sanitizer. We should wrap with triple backticks and add language tag in the markdown or escape with <>. Prefer code fence.

sam-docs: Agreed. Also our SDK snippets generator strips leading/trailing backticks for inline snippets. I'll push a small tweak to the snippet tool to preserve fences.

maddie-ux: UX note: examples with outputs should show token cost micro-breakdown inline. Can we add a tiny cost row after snippet? e.g., "approx 12 tokens / $0.0003" — makes it tangible.

nina-qa: Small concern: rust example in the same page uses a raw string literal that doesn't escape braces; it fails to compile. I'll add a CI check to run cargo check against snippet. PR incoming.

sam-docs: Great — can we also add a link fix? The "dashboard preshared keys" link 404s; should point to /console/security/keys. I'll include in PR.

deploy-bot: deploy-status: docs-preview build queued for PR 3582

anna: I'll open PR 3582-fix-snippets; will include markdown fence + token cost row + link patch + rust fix. Assigning reviewers @sam-docs @leo-eng

leo-eng: Quick code suggestion — for python use raw triple-quote to avoid escaping:
```
prompt = r'''Summarize: <user_input>
Tags: <tags>'''
```

sam-docs: Thanks, pushing changes; linking to the preview once build finishes.

deploy-bot: deploy-status: docs-preview for PR 3582 succeeded — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-3582--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/presets

maddie-ux: Preview looks good. Can we also add the small cost legend below examples? visual team will approve.

nina-qa: CI check ran snippet cargo check: passed. leaving a nit about wording.

anna: Thanks everyone. I'll merge after one more voice from @sam-docs. :thumbsup:

sam-docs: LGTM. merge when ready. :shipit:
